## Usage

Append-only execution log for the rendering rewrite effort.

Every log item should record:

- `Item`
- `Status`
- `Details`
- `Next action`

Recommended status values:

- `todo`
- `in_progress`
- `done`
- `blocked`
- `deferred`

Record:

- architecture decisions
- renderer spike results
- benchmark evidence
- visual parity checks
- `xyflow` keep/fork/replace decisions
- handoff and interaction regressions
- rollout gates for dense scenes

## 2026-03-26 002

- Item: Tighten the rewrite plan around strict scene ownership, cleanup-first implementation, and append-only branch handoff discipline.
- Status: `in_progress`
- Details:
  - Revised the rewrite plan to encode the stricter graph-surface rule:
    - visible graph pixels should stay scene-owned by default
    - DOM should be limited to popups, heavyweight editors, and thin interaction adapters unless a whole-node overlay is explicitly justified
  - Added the immediate editor interaction rule:
    - CodeMirror-backed fields and code blocks must begin editing on the first click
    - no activation-click model is acceptable
  - Added the graph-widget scope rule:
    - graph-surface drag/reorder paths such as dict/list/kanban interactions should be expected to move scene-native over time
    - preserve behavior semantics even when the DOM drag plumbing changes
  - Added the cleanup-first workflow rule for the future branch:
    - before modifying a messy target file, use the relevant architecture/cleanup skill guidance first
    - clean up the file or cluster before landing Pixi/scene work in it
  - Added the TDD execution rule for each work item:
    - read baseline/context
    - clean up target file or cluster
    - write tests for the new behavior
    - implement
    - run tests/verification
    - append the log with status and next action
  - Added the branch-transfer note:
    - these plan/log files are being prepared in the current worktree so they can be copied into the new branch after it is created from `main`
- Next action:
  - Create the new branch from `main`, transfer the revised plan/log files, and start the vertical slice with a cleanup-first, test-first pass on the first target file cluster.

## 2026-03-31 365

- Item: Stop one live Pixi scene fallback from clearing Pixi's shared texture pools for sibling `All Settings` cards.
- Status: `done`
- Details:
  - Continued directly from item `364` because the deferred CDP gate repeated the same clean-bootstrap blocker instead of surfacing a new parity drift:
    - with a fresh runtime token, the live Pixi route no longer reproduced the earlier stale-token auth caveat
    - but the page still hit `Unhandled Thrown Error! TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')`
    - the crash stack pointed at `TexturePoolClass.returnTexture` / `CanvasTextSystem.returnTexture` before the graph surface could stay trustworthy
  - Root cause for this bounded slice:
    - each `LiveDictAreaPixiScene` instance was tearing down with `app.destroy(true, true)`
    - the boolean renderer destroy flag tells Pixi to release page-global pooled resources, including the shared texture pool
    - on `All Settings`, one scene falling back after `webglcontextlost` could therefore clear the shared pool while sibling live Pixi scene apps were still mounted, which matches the repeated `returnTexture(...).push` crash
  - Fixed the production scene teardown boundary:
    - `frontend/src/components/Params/LiveDictAreaPixiScene.tsx`
      - added a narrow scene-destroy helper that still removes the torn-down canvas view
      - switched both the cancelled-init path and the unmount cleanup from `app.destroy(true, true)` to `app.destroy({ removeView: true }, true)` so an individual scene teardown no longer releases Pixi's global pools for the whole page
  - Added focused regression coverage for the new teardown contract:
    - `frontend/src/components/Params/LiveDictAreaPixiScene.test.ts`
      - added a unit test that renders a real scene, unmounts it, and requires `Application.destroy` to receive `{ removeView: true }` instead of the global-resource-releasing boolean flag
- Verification:

    - `pnpm -C frontend exec prettier --write src/components/Params/LiveDictAreaPixiScene.tsx src/components/Params/LiveDictAreaPixiScene.test.ts`
